text: This reagent must not be handled outside the fume hood.
Weigh out the powder. Then make up the solution.
Once the mixture is clear, incubate the tubes.
Do not rinse the glassware until the batch is complete.
Waste must be discarded in the marked container.
Before you start, label every tube.
Rinse thoroughly, except after the final incubation.

Right, everybody, this is the induction and it takes four minutes, so please do not start unpacking yet. Three rules, and they are the three that people break in their first fortnight. Rule one. Label every tube before you fill it, not after. I know that sounds obvious and I have thrown away an entire afternoon of somebody else's work because four identical tubes came back to the rack with nothing written on them. Rule two. Waste goes in the marked container by the door and nowhere else. Not the sink, not the general bin, not a beaker you are planning to deal with later. Rule three, and this is the one that matters most. If a protocol says a reagent must not be handled outside the fume hood, that is not a recommendation and it is not there because somebody is being careful. Somebody was hurt, and the sentence was added afterwards. If you are not sure whether a step applies to you, stop and ask. Nobody in this building has ever been annoyed by that question.

Hi, it is me, listen, do not run the protocol the way it is printed, I meant to catch you before you left yesterday. Step four changed last month and the copy on the bench is the old one. So: weigh out the powder as normal, that part is the same, but make up the solution with the buffer from the fridge and not the one on the shelf. They look identical and the labels are almost the same, which is exactly the problem. Then, and this is the actual change, allow the tubes to stand for five minutes before you add the reagent. The old version had you adding it straight away and the batch came out cloudy every single time. After that, incubate for twenty minutes as usual. One more thing, and then I will let you go. Do not rinse the glassware until the whole batch is finished, because if you rinse halfway through you will have nothing to compare the last four tubes against. Text me when you are done.
Before you start, label every tube.
Once the mixture is clear, incubate the tubes.
Do not rinse the glassware until the batch is complete.
Waste must be discarded in the marked container.
This reagent must not be handled outside the fume hood.
Rinse thoroughly, except after the final incubation.
